qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, incl. EXT, sulfate and UDP-sugar transporter defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan chain biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern building HS/heparin and CS/DS chains or their inherited defects (EXT1/2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1), unlike the degradation/MPS confusable and the broader O-/N-glycan and keratan sulfate confusables.

qualifier: intracellular domain release across NOTCH1-4, incl. ligand-independent NOTCH1 mutants
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and intracellular domain release
rationale: Members describe cleavage of Notch receptors (NOTCH1-4, incl. constitutive HD/translocation mutants) to release the intracellular domain, whereas confusables centre on NICD-driven transcription and negative regulation.

core: Neural tube dorsoventral patterning and neuron fate specification
qualifier: spinal cord and hindbrain motor neurons and interneurons
name: Spinal cord and hindbrain motor and interneuron fate specification
rationale: Members cover dorsoventral patterning and motor/interneuron specification in spinal cord and hindbrain (incl. brainstem respiratory control), unlike confusables on axial mesoderm/floor plate, midbrain dopaminergic neurons or pons maturation.

qualifier: negative feedback, incl. mutants escaping it
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK1/2
rationale: All three members concern switching off ERK by feedback dephosphorylation (and ERK mutants that evade it), distinct from JNK/p38, RSK/MAP2K, AP-1 and ERK5 confusables.

qualifier: erythroid and megakaryocytic branch
name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic lineage differentiation
rationale: Nearly all members concern red cell and platelet/megakaryocyte development (RUNX1, TAL1-GFI1B, enucleation, oxygen transport), whereas confusables cover myeloid/granulocytic progenitors and HSC maintenance.

qualifier: at early and late endosome membranes
name: Endosomal phosphoinositide synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members concern PIP interconversion on endosomes, unlike confusables on Golgi/plasma-membrane PIPs, inositol phosphates, endosome-Golgi traffic or autophagosome fusion.

qualifier: 5-HT receptor level, ionotropic and G protein-coupled
name: Serotonin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are serotonin receptor signaling routes (cAMP up/down, PLC, gated cation channel), distinct from confusables on serotonin synthesis/uptake, histamine, muscarinic or gut motility.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and microbe killing
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members share neutrophil/macrophage effector killing via ROS/NADPH oxidase and degranulation against bacteria and fungi, unlike confusables on Fc-receptor/ADCC, formyl peptide chemotaxis or anti-inflammatory signaling.

core: Cellular sodium and potassium transport regulation
qualifier: osmosensing and hypo/hyperosmotic response
name: Osmotic stress response and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members combine osmosensing responses with regulation of Na+/K+ (and Cl-) transmembrane and renal transport, distinct from confusables on salt stress/water homeostasis, aldosterone, or cation-chloride cotransporters and K+ channels.

qualifier: GABA synthesis/degradation and glycinergic transmission
name: GABA and glycine neurotransmitter synthesis, release and reuptake
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake plus glycinergic transmission (SLC6A5), unlike confusables on glutamate/aspartate transport or cholinergic transmission.

qualifier: Cdc20-dependent, phosphorylation-activated
name: APC/C-Cdc20 phospho-activation and mitotic substrate degradation
rationale: Members concern APC/C phosphorylation, inhibition and Cdc20-directed degradation of cyclins, securin and Nek2A to drive mitotic exit, distinct from confusables on Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching, Emi1 and metaphase/anaphase cohesion.

core: Early germline and embryonic stem lineage specification
qualifier: primordial germ cells, inner cell mass and trophectoderm
name: Primordial germ cell and preimplantation lineage specification
rationale: Members span PGC specification, migration and proliferation, germline stem cell maintenance and ICM/trophectoderm differentiation, unlike confusables on trophoblast/decidua, testis somatic cells or oocyte maturation.

qualifier: Leloir pathway defects, lactose synthesis and disaccharide digestion
name: Galactose and lactose metabolism and dietary disaccharide digestion
rationale: Members concern galactose catabolism (and GALT/GALK1/GALE/GALM defects), lactose synthesis and intestinal disaccharide hydrolysis, distinct from fructose, pentose and hexose-transporter confusables.

core: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix and adhesion program
qualifier: EMT and mechanoresponsive fibroblast matrix with focal adhesion assembly
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition and fibroblast matrix-adhesion program
rationale: Members share a mesenchymal ECM/adhesion program (EMT hallmark, YAP/TAZ-CCN fibroblast module, collagen/TGF-beta, focal adhesion), unlike confusables centred on fibronectin, syndecan/integrin migration or resident stromal markers.

qualifier: negative feedback on steroid and endocrine secretion
name: Glucocorticoid response and negative feedback on steroid secretion
rationale: Members concern responses to cortisol/dexamethasone and negative regulation of glucocorticoid signaling and steroid secretion, whereas confusables cover stimulation of cortisol/ACTH secretion, stress behaviour and circadian metabolism.

qualifier: CFTR-centred, exocrine and intestinal
name: CFTR-centred epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Most members concern anion-driven water secretion in exocrine and intestinal epithelia (CFTR defects/trafficking, saliva, pancreatic juice, infectious diarrhoea), which distinguishes it from TRP/pH-sensing, apical surface and basolateral secretion confusables.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and ciliary cargo targeting
name: Primary cilium assembly and intraciliary cargo trafficking
rationale: Members concern IFT, BBSome/ARL13B/VxPx cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking plus cilium assembly/disassembly control, unlike confusables on motile/multiciliated cilia, photoreceptors or centrosome organisation.

qualifier: SSA, MMEJ and presynaptic RAD51 loading before D-loop resolution
name: DNA end resection and presynaptic double-strand break repair
rationale: Members share resection of DSB ends and the resection-dependent routes (SSA, alt-NHEJ, BRCA2-RAD51 presynaptic loading), unlike confusables on D-loop resolution, classical NHEJ or break sensing.

qualifier: naive, memory, germinal centre and plasma cell states
name: B cell differentiation to memory and plasma cells
rationale: Members are B-cell, memory and plasma-cell signatures plus germinal centre/Tfh regulation of B cell differentiation, distinct from confusables on B-1 cells, CD27 and BCR signaling.

qualifier: oncogenic BRAF/RAF1, Rap1 and integrin inputs
name: RAF-to-ERK activation by oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members concern RAF-MEK-ERK activation including BRAF/RAF1 mutants and fusions, with Rap1 and integrin linkage as inputs, unlike confusables on RAS GAP regulation, MRAS/SHOC2 or ERK negative feedback.

core: Membrane remodeling at endocytic and organelle contacts
qualifier: clathrin coat cycling plus Miro and mitochondria-ER tethering
name: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis and organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members split between clathrin coat assembly/disassembly in synaptic vesicle and gap-junction endocytosis and membrane docking/tethering (RHOT1/2, mito-ER, autophagosome, membrane repair), the latter distinguishing it from presynaptic confusables.

qualifier: lamina depolymerization and initiation of reformation
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation initiation
rationale: All three members concern lamina depolymerization and nuclear membrane disassembly/early reformation in mitosis, distinct from ESCRT-III sealing and nuclear pore complex confusables.

qualifier: postsynaptic LTP/LTD and spine/synapse maturation
name: Promotion of synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maturation
rationale: Members positively regulate LTP, LTD, spine morphogenesis and synapse maturation with postsynaptic calcium and short-term memory, unlike confusables on spine maintenance, reelin, or CREB/synaptic translation.

qualifier: core circadian feedback loop and MECP2
name: Core circadian clock feedback and MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription
rationale: Members combine the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER feedback loop with MECP2, CREB/NPAS4 and HDAC transcriptional control in neurons, unlike confusables limited to MECP2-GABA targets, cAMP/PKA-CREB or circadian output genes.

qualifier: collagen/TGF-beta stromal signaling and focal adhesion assembly
name: Collagen and TGF-beta stromal signaling with focal adhesion assembly
rationale: The three members share stromal matrix signaling at the plasma membrane driving focal adhesion assembly, distinct from confusables on fibronectin, syndecan/integrin, stress fibres or MET-driven spreading.
